ur5e.model: Harmonic Drive CSG-25-100 (joints 1-3) / CSG-14-100 (wrists), sized to the UR5e joint caps

per_joint.life_model: min(bearing, teeth). Bearing: L10 = 10,000 h x (T_r / T_av)^3 x (n_r / n_av), T_r 87 N.m, n_r 2,000 rpm input. Teeth: rainflow cycles (ASTM E1049) on N = 1e+07 x (204 / T)^11.66 above the repeated peak (1e+04 cycles at the momentary peak), Miner's rule. ESTIMATE. Sources: https://www.harmonicdrive.net/_hd/content/documents/csf-csg.pdf - CSG rating table (Table 3, p. 11): size 25, ratio 100; wave-generator L10 10,000 h at rated torque and 2,000 rpm, life equation 8, momentary-peak count equation 7 (1.0e4), repeated peak = infinite flexspline fatigue life (p. 12-13)

qdd.model: CubeMars AK10-9 9:1 (joints 1-3) / AK70-10 10:1 (wrists), the largest 9-10:1 QDDs in robotparts

per_joint.life_model: min(bearing, teeth). Bearing: L10 = 3,000 h x (T_r / T_av)^3 x (n_r / n_av), T_r 18 N.m, n_r 2,115 rpm input.
